note: San Bernardino County regional park on the Colorado River 11 mi SE of Needles, run by the Pirate Cove Resort concession. The riverfront Peninsula sites are clusters of pads on the sand beach; the inland RV sites are back from the water (sites 10-21 in winter only). Marina, launch ramp, restaurant and an OHV staging area for the nearby dunes and trails. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT riverfront CONFIRMED (with a sand caveat): resort map 'Peninsula Sites 1-15' (South Peninsula) and '16-25' (North Peninsula), each a cluster of lettered pads, sold by the night ($75-90 peak, $70 winter); Esri shows the South Peninsula clusters on open sand along the Colorado River main channel (~250 m wide), RVs 7-15 m from the waterline at the pin 34.7315,-114.5072, no trees or bank in between. The inland RV sites (1-21 and the block by the water park) are 150+ m from the river and not waterfront.

SAND (EKKO no-open-beach-sand rule - AWH call): the Peninsula pads look like bare beach sand off paved Peninsula Way ('Spacious pads ... on the beach'). The campground itself stays (inland full-hookup sites), but if the Peninsula pads count as open-beach sand, riverfront rests on sites a 2WD rig shouldn't use.

OHV (flag only, never drop): the resort runs an off-road staging area ('Start your off road fun at our staging area'; 'OHV Dunes' on the map) but is a general riverfront RV resort with marina, cabins and restaurant - a general campground with an OHV side.
PRICE (local ownership, not price-gated): with the mandatory $10 utility charge the Peninsula is $85-100 peak non-holiday ($76.50-90 after Good Sam 10% off the site rate); inland $60-65.

LONG STAY: winter monthly rates ($800-900) and a separate Mobile Home Park beside the RV area; nightly RV booking open all year ('Always open to the public'). Nightly share not measurable from the map; nothing discourages nightly stays.
PHONE: 760-326-9000 confirmed (toll-free 1-866-301-3000). WEBSITES: both stored links live (https://www.piratecoveresort.com/ resolves to https://piratecoveresort.com/, Cloudflare-blocks curl).
